name: Declan O'Malley
bio:
Declan O'Malley's path to motorsport finance began unconventionally, starting with a degree in accounting followed by a stint at a Dublin-based investment bank. Dissatisfied with the corporate world, he sought a role that combined his financial acumen with his lifelong passion for racing. An opening at a smaller racing team offered him the opportunity to immerse himself in the sport’s unique economic challenges. 

At McLaren, Declan brings a sharp focus to cost management and revenue generation. He believes in rigorous analysis and proactive financial planning. His approach is data-driven, always seeking opportunities to improve efficiency and maximize resource allocation. He is known for his ability to navigate the complex financial landscape of Formula 1, ensuring the team remains competitive while adhering to strict budgetary constraints. What sets Declan apart is his deep understanding of the sport, which informs every financial decision he makes.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Declan is of average height, with a serious demeanor reflected in his sharp features.
